title: Are naps actually good for us? | Sleeping with Science
speaker: TED
zh: 【TED】午睡真的對我們有好處嗎？ |與科學共眠（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.zh: 我們先天的設計有包括 在白天小睡片刻嗎？ 〔從科學看睡眠〕

cues.text: Are we designed to nap during the day?
cues.en: Are we designed to nap during the day?
cues.zh: 我們先天的設計有包括 在白天小睡片刻嗎？

cues.text: Most people aim to get their recommended seven to nine hours of sleep
cues.en: Most people aim to get their recommended seven to nine hours of sleep
cues.zh: 多數人會希望在晚上一口氣睡足

cues.text: in one long stretch at night.
cues.en: in one long stretch at night.
cues.zh: 多數人會希望在晚上一口氣睡足 建議的七到九個小時。 專業術語叫做「單相睡眠」。

cues.text: And the technical term for this is “monophasic sleep.” In other words, a single bout of sleep at night.
cues.en: And the technical term for this is “monophasic sleep.” In other words, a single bout of sleep at night.
cues.zh: 專業術語叫做「單相睡眠」。 換句話說，就是隻睡晚上一回合。

cues.text: However, we may not have been programmed to sleep in this way.
cues.en: However, we may not have been programmed to sleep in this way.
cues.zh: 然而 我們先天上不見得適合 這種睡眠方式。

cues.text: Now I'm sure you've had that experience of a drop in your alertness in the afternoon,
cues.en: Now I'm sure you've had that experience of a drop in your alertness in the afternoon,
cues.zh: 我相信你有過這種經驗： 在午後有點精神不濟，

cues.text: where you start to feel a little sleepy.
cues.en: where you start to feel a little sleepy.
cues.zh: 開始有點愛睏。

cues.text: And you can also see it in other people as well, as their heads begin sort of bobbing up and down
cues.en: And you can also see it in other people as well, as their heads begin sort of bobbing up and down
cues.zh: 你會看到別人也有這個狀況， 因為在下午的會議中 他們會開始一直點頭。

cues.text: during afternoon meetings.
cues.en: during afternoon meetings.
cues.zh: 因為在下午的會議中 他們會開始一直點頭。

cues.text: Now you may think this afternoon drop in your alertness
cues.en: Now you may think this afternoon drop in your alertness
cues.zh: 你可能認為下午之所以精神不濟

cues.text: is because of a big lunch, but in actual fact,
cues.en: is because of a big lunch, but in actual fact,
cues.zh: 是因為午餐吃太飽， 但事實上，

cues.text: it seems to be hardwired.
cues.en: it seems to be hardwired.
cues.zh: 這似乎是天生的。

cues.text: Because if I place electrodes on your head, there is a reliable, preprogrammed drop
cues.en: Because if I place electrodes on your head, there is a reliable, preprogrammed drop
cues.zh: 因為如果我把電極連線在你的頭上， 下午時，大腦的注意力

cues.text: in your brain’s alertness during the afternoon.
cues.en: in your brain’s alertness during the afternoon.
cues.zh: 下午時，大腦的注意力 確實就會如原廠商設定般下降。

cues.text: And it happens to most of us somewhere between the one to four pm mark.
cues.en: And it happens to most of us somewhere between the one to four pm mark.
cues.zh: 大部分人發生這個狀況的時間 大約是在下午一點到四點間。 這就意味著我們可能

cues.text: What this suggests is that we may have been designed to sleep in a biphasic pattern,
cues.en: What this suggests is that we may have been designed to sleep in a biphasic pattern,
cues.zh: 這就意味著我們可能 在先天的設計上 就適合用雙相的模式來睡覺， 意即，晚上睡比較長的一回合，

cues.text: meaning one longer bout of sleep at night and then a short afternoon nap during the day,
cues.en: meaning one longer bout of sleep at night and then a short afternoon nap during the day,
cues.zh: 意即，晚上睡比較長的一回合， 接著，白天午後再打個小盹，

cues.text: very much like the siesta cultures around the world.
cues.en: very much like the siesta cultures around the world.
cues.zh: 非常像現在世界各地的午覺文化。

cues.text: But is napping always a good thing?
cues.en: But is napping always a good thing?
cues.zh: 但打盹一定是好的嗎？

cues.text: Well, not necessarily.
cues.en: Well, not necessarily.
cues.zh: 不見得喔。

cues.text: Although we and other scientists have discovered that naps can have benefits
cues.en: Although we and other scientists have discovered that naps can have benefits
cues.zh: 雖然我們及其他科學家發現， 打盹對於大腦和身體都有益處，

cues.text: for both the brain and for the body, naps can be a double-edged sword.
cues.en: for both the brain and for the body, naps can be a double-edged sword.
cues.zh: 打盹對於大腦和身體都有益處， 打盹也可能是雙面刃。 下午或傍晚若打盹的時間太長，

cues.text: Long naps in the afternoon or in the early evening
cues.en: Long naps in the afternoon or in the early evening
cues.zh: 下午或傍晚若打盹的時間太長，

cues.text: can just take the edge off your sleepiness.
cues.en: can just take the edge off your sleepiness.
cues.zh: 會削減你的睡意。

cues.text: It's a little bit like snacking before your main meal.
cues.en: It's a little bit like snacking before your main meal.
cues.zh: 有點像是吃正餐之前來點零食。

cues.text: So if you are struggling with sleep at night, the best advice is not to nap during the day.
cues.en: So if you are struggling with sleep at night, the best advice is not to nap during the day.
cues.zh: 所以，如果你晚上很難入眠， 最好的建議是白天不要打盹。

cues.text: Instead, build up all of that healthy sleepiness
cues.en: Instead, build up all of that healthy sleepiness
cues.zh: 反而要累積健康的睡意， 你才最有機會可以輕鬆入睡，

cues.text: so that you give yourself the best chance of falling asleep easily
cues.en: so that you give yourself the best chance of falling asleep easily
cues.zh: 你才最有機會可以輕鬆入睡， 且好眠到一覺到天亮。

cues.text: and then staying asleep soundly across the night.
cues.en: and then staying asleep soundly across the night.
cues.zh: 且好眠到一覺到天亮。 但如果你沒有睡眠問題，

cues.text: But if you're not struggling with sleep and you can nap regularly during the day,
cues.en: But if you're not struggling with sleep and you can nap regularly during the day,
cues.zh: 但如果你沒有睡眠問題， 白天有固定時間可以打盹，

cues.text: the naps of around 20 minutes taken early in the day
cues.en: the naps of around 20 minutes taken early in the day
cues.zh: 那麼白天早一點小睡大約二十分鐘 沒什麼問題。

cues.text: can be just fine.
cues.en: can be just fine.
cues.zh: 沒什麼問題。
